description: Waivers the Owner has granted. A row names a need (a type and a subject; subject '*' is every subject of the type: the type has no working checker yet), gives a reason and says where and when the Owner approved it. A waiver covers a need that is open or inconclusive and never one that failed.

future_scope.description: What has to exist for the waiver to end

approval_ref.description: Where the Owner's approval was given: a link, or the words quoted
